_comment: Bounded masked-depth config fragment for the live_pose transfer staging run, handed to the integration lane (twin-robot-in-store-boot-v1). Merge the keys below INTO the mission-runtime config's `masked_depth` block. All keys are backward compatible and default-safe; omitting them is byte-identical except that a per-op manip failure now keeps the station feed alive (the intended fix, no key required). Gate any change with `python3 scripts/twin/restock/gpu_budget.py <this-config>` BEFORE booting.

masked_depth.runtime_env: <host overlay env.sh — unchanged from the current config>
masked_depth._supervisor_defaults: The bridge supervises + restarts the publisher automatically; these knobs only tune it and are OPTIONAL (shown with their defaults).

mast_depth._comment: KEEP OFF for live_pose transfer: gpu_budget confirms one arm feed fits the 12 GB card with whispr resident (11882/12288 MiB, 26 free) but a SECOND full-res feed does not. Enable only after a resolution cut that the budget gate passes AND an on-card peak sample confirms.
